posts.text: 🇷🇺 Impact of strikes on Western arms supplies Early in the SMO, speculation arose that destroying the Beskid Tunnel would halt Ukraine's supply lines. While this tunnel handles over 40% of transit cargo to Central and Western Europe, it is not the sole route. Logistical realities Western aid arrives via multiple rail and road corridors. If the tunnel were disabled, trains carrying heavy equipment would face significant delays due to rerouting or waiting for slots on other congested lines. Transporting such loads by highway requires more resources and time. Russian strategy shift The Russian MoD has opted for a different approach: systematically targeting Ukrainian locomotives and rolling stock. This method effectively reduces transport capacity without the high difficulty associated with neutralising hardened tunnel infrastructure. @Slavyangrad
